prompt:
Create a workflow named "eval-split-batches", run manually. A Code node emits
seven items {"n":1} ... {"n":7}. Loop over them in batches of 3 with the Split In
Batches (Loop Over Items) node, and on each batch set the field "processed" to true.
When the loop is done, count the processed items with an Aggregate node (count)
into the field "processed_count".
